title: cairn categories
description: Names and order for the category groups. Docs: https://github.com/MorganKryze/cairn/blob/main/docs/reference.md#categoriesyaml

id.description: Slug matching the services' category key.

name.description: Display name, translatable. Defaults to the id, capitalized.

order.description: Explicitly ordered categories come first, ascending; the rest are alphabetical.
